sloka: स लोकपालप्रतिमप्रभाववाम् ।स्तीर्त्वा महात्मा वरदो महानदीम् ।ततः समृद्धान् शुभसस्यमालिनः ।क्रमेण वत्सान् मुदितानुपागमत् ॥२-५२-१०१॥
transliteration: sa lokapālapratimaprabhāvavām ।stīrtvā mahātmā varado mahānadīm ।tataḥ samṛddhān śubhasasyamālinaḥ ।krameṇa vatsān muditānupāgamat ॥2-52-101॥

translations.english: Having crossed that mighty river, the highsouled Rama, bestower of boons and equal in splendour, to the Protector of the world reached Vatsa by and by, a highly prosperous country inhabited by happy people.
